headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save. Charles McAdoo led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Jameson Taillon, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to right forearm tendinitis. Other notable injuries include Kyle Stowers (Miami Marlins) with a left hamstring strain, Daniel Susac (San Francisco Giants) with a left knee patella fracture, and Devin Williams (New York Mets) with a right shoulder strain.

The Kansas City Royals made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade announced on August 5, 2026. Other notable trades include the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics for RF Colby Thomas, and the Miami Marlins trading RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save. Charles McAdoo led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-9 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took down the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5, securing a hard-fought win. Andrew Painter earned the win for the Phillies, while Jonathan Bowlan notched the save.

top_news.title: **Taillon Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-hander Jameson Taillon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm tendinitis.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire 1B Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that was announced on August 5, 2026.
